name: dev-flow-codex
description: Dev Flow tasks in local branches or dedicated worktrees for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Assess and continue Dev Flow tasks
interface.longDescription: Assess development requests before choosing direct work or Dev Flow. Default to a new task branch in the current directory; explicitly choose the current branch or a dedicated worktree when needed. Preserve confirmed initial content and resume the same Core Task in its original directory. The $dev-flow-codex:dev-flow selector does not skip assessment.
defaultPrompt: $dev-flow-codex:dev-flow assess the requested change in this repository before starting Dev Flow.
